name: Fukamachi Sachi
source: A childhood friend of the protagonist who he hasn't see in seven years. While being a high school student, she attends a cram school at night in Monday and Friday. Because of that, her mom asks the protagonist to let her stay with him in the days when cram starts. Thus, after years of being apart, they meet again at the protagonist's apartment.
